claims.scope: Finite spaces realized; infinite minimal convergence actions have perfect compacta, countable groups, and finite kernel.
Bowditch annulus axioms A1-A3 imply an equivariant hyperbolic boundary realization, with an explicit isometric graph realization.
Uniform equicontinuous remetrization and the specified fixed-height lift fail; neither is necessary for the original target.
Every finite-orbit annulus graph for the PSL2Z circle action has the wrong equivariant boundary. The same action is realized on H2.
All annuli violate A1; sums and maxima of hyperbolic pseudometrics need not be hyperbolic.

remaining_gap: Construct a uniform quasi-action realizing every prescribed compact minimal convergence boundary, or exhibit an action for which no such realization exists.
